assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And the dialog named "Leave Now?" on the Home page is visible
4. When User A clicks the button labelled "Logout" inside the dialog named "Leave Now?" on the Home page
5. And the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
6. Then the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible
7. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible
8. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible
9. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent
10. And installed access, refresh, identity, expiry, and login-time state equal their cleared logout defaults
